tools.name: CA_V3 Viewer
tools.description: Read-only Android viewer for CA_V3 (also one self-contained HTML file for a PC browser or the Tool Bench): system design, open tasks, health, live sessions, drift and the framework graph, from the CA_V3 Dashboard, Sessions and Framework Graph APIs. Never writes to CA_V3. Release record: std:external_links repos[komposing/ca-v3-viewer].
